objective: Cron trigger support for backend script execution and frontend React Flow editor

acceptance.criterion: parse_five_field_cron converts valid 5-field cron expressions to 6-field and rejects malformed or 6-field inputs with error message
is_due correctly evaluates schedule occurrences against current time and last fired timestamp
GET /cron-preview returns next occurrences for valid 5-field cron expressions
Frontend Cron UI editor and useCronPreview hook allow configuring cron schedules and displaying next run times
